run_GTestBreakOnFailureUnitTest: run the googletest break-on-failure unit test suite to verify seg-fault behavior on assertion failures
test_RunAndVerify: test the RunAndVerify method to check if a command generates a seg-fault with given env var and flag values
test_testDefaultBehavior: test the default behavior of googletest break-on-failure mode without any environment variables or flags set
test_testEnvVar: test using the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable to enable or disable break-on-failure mode
test_testFlagOverridesEnvVar: test that the gtest_break_on_failure command line flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
